contact.tagline: Available for focused collaborations and high-quality digital work.

about.tagline: Short, clear context about who I am and how I work
about.statement: I create digital work that is simple, clean and worth showing.
about.intro: I am Wiktor from Poland, building under the name Nozercode. I work across graphics, short videos, websites and game assets, with the same goal every time: turn an idea into something clear, useful and well-made.
about.sideNote: My direction is straightforward: fewer things, better executed, with more taste and more control each year.

origin.title: Why I started
origin.text: Nozercode started because I wanted to build something of my own and use my skills in a real way. It began small, but the point was always the same: keep improving until the work feels genuinely solid.

currentWork.title: What I do now
currentWork.text: Right now I work between graphic design, short-form video, websites and Roblox-related assets. The medium changes, but the approach stays the same: make it clean, readable and intentional.

drives.title: How I think about quality
drives.text: I care more about precision than volume. I would rather publish less and know it is polished than fill the page with work that does not say much.

randomFacts.text: In 2025, I won the biggest graphic design contest at my local school, earning prizes worth over USD 1,000.
I have already traveled to more than eight countries.
I have two pets: a cockatiel parrot and a crested gecko.
I reached Rysy peak in Slovakia and also climbed other mountain peaks in Poland and Slovakia.
I participated in the Erasmus+ project in Malaga, Spain.
I can move my left ear and crack three fingers on my hands.
I love playing Roblox, especially meeting new people on voice chat.

favorites.subtitle: Get to know me
favorites.intro: A quick look at what I enjoy most.

items.name: Roblox
items.description: My favorite game to play with friends and enjoy on a daily basis.

items.name: Minecraft
items.description: A creative game with huge possibilities and endless room for imagination.

items.name: World Of Tanks
items.description: I enjoy the strategy, the different modes, and the satisfying progression system.

items.name: CS2
items.description: A fun competitive game that really rewards practice, focus, and mastery.

items.name: Interstellar
items.description: My favorite Christopher Nolan sci-fi film and one of the most unforgettable movie experiences for me.

items.name: Joker
items.description: It makes me reflect on loneliness, relationships, and the state of a person's mind.

items.name: Money Heist
items.description: One of my favorite series for its tension, style, and unforgettable characters.

items.name: Projekt Hail Mary
items.description: A favorite for its mix of science, scale, and a story that stays exciting the whole way through.

items.name: Spring
items.description: I like the calm atmosphere, blooming trees, and the feeling that everything starts again.

projects.title: NozerTools
projects.subtitle: Mini apps hub
projects.summary: NozerTools is a free platform packed with practical online tools for productivity, self-care, and creativity. It is designed to give people fast, intuitive solutions in one place while keeping everything private and local to the device.
projects.banner: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(106, 62, 47, 0.7), rgba(76, 44, 35, 0.88) 45%, rgba(41, 24, 20, 0.96)), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 34%, rgba(255, 241, 238, 0.18), transparent 20%), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 64%, rgba(255, 244, 241, 0.16), transparent 12%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(67, 40, 33, 0.92), rgba(42, 24, 20, 0.98))
highlights: Multiple practical apps gathered in one place
Built to support productivity, self-care, and creative workflows
Fast and easy to use without unnecessary friction
No data collection - everything stays in local storage

projects.title: Non Stop FM Radio
projects.subtitle: Los Santos live radio 24/7
projects.summary: This fan-made radio website is inspired by Non Stop Pop FM from Grand Theft Auto V. It lets visitors listen to a live-style broadcast, check the currently playing song, and jump directly to selected tracks through a sleek custom interface.
highlights: High-quality audio playback with a focused custom player
24/7 radio concept inspired by the GTA V station experience
Shows current tracks and supports manual song selection
Designed as a polished tribute project for fans of the original station

projects.title: Poko
projects.subtitle: Budget & Finance App
projects.summary: Poko helps users track income, split expenses by category, manage debts, and work toward savings goals without creating an account. The app combines practical budgeting tools with clean charts, gamification, and AI-powered coaching for a more engaging finance experience.
projects.banner: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88), rgba(245, 245, 247, 0.96) 48%, rgba(224, 224, 228, 0.98) 100%), radial-gradient(circle at 67% 30%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.92), transparent 12%), radial-gradient(circle at 67% 30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88), transparent 20%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 64, 64, 0.16), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 35%)
highlights: Budget tracking, debt management, and savings goals in one app
Gamification system with XP, levels, and unlockable badges
Claude AI budget coach that delivers practical personalised tips
Free to use, no account required, and privacy-focused by design

projects.title: Heaven Community Roblox
projects.subtitle: My Roblox group with products and games
projects.summary: Heaven Community Roblox is an active Roblox brand where I create and sell solutions for both developers and regular players. The group focuses on games, scripts, clothing, and other Roblox assets designed to balance quality, originality, and accessible pricing.
projects.banner: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(89, 16, 45, 0.5), rgba(66, 12, 38, 0.78) 42%, rgba(24, 10, 22, 0.94) 100%), repeating-linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 0 38px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 38px 76px), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 26%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12), transparent 20%)
highlights: Original Roblox products built for developers and players
Custom services alongside ready-to-use assets and creations
Strong quality-to-price balance across the offer
Ongoing community brand with products, games, and social presence

projects.title: NozerBin
projects.subtitle: Anonymous post publishing platform
projects.summary: NozerBin is a privacy-focused platform for posting anonymous text updates. It is built to keep sharing simple, fast, and private while giving users a safe place to publish short thoughts without registration.
projects.banner: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(11, 35, 67, 0.92), rgba(12, 45, 96, 0.88) 40%, rgba(17, 77, 151, 0.85) 100%), radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.08), transparent 18%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06), transparent 14%)
highlights: Anonymous posting with no login required
Clear, mobile-friendly feed for fast browsing
Built around privacy and minimum data collection
Simple moderation workflow for safer content
